read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Read XMP Metadata from PDF
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF file to a PdfXmpMetadata facade and retrieve its XMP metadata as a byte array.

create-pdf-with-xmp-metadata.title: Create PDF with XMP Metadata
create-pdf-with-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to generate a new PDF, register XMP namespaces, add custom XMP metadata entries, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-and-modify-xmp-metadata.title: Detect and Modify XMP Metadata in PDF
detect-and-modify-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfXmpMetadata, check for existing XMP metadata, add a custom XMP property, and save the modified document.

set-baseurl-in-pdf-xmp-metadata.title: Set BaseURL in PDF XMP Metadata
set-baseurl-in-pdf-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to add or replace the BaseURL property in a PDF's XMP metadata using the PdfXmpMetadata facade from Aspose.Pdf.

set-creator-tool-xmp-metadata.title: Set CreatorTool in PDF XMP Metadata
set-creator-tool-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to assign the xmp:CreatorTool property in a PDF's XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save the updated file.

set-xmp-nickname-property.title: Set XMP Nickname Property in PDF
set-xmp-nickname-property.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, add or update the XMP Nickname metadata property, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-nickname-from-xmp-metadata.title: Remove Nickname Element from PDF XMP Metadata
remove-nickname-from-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, remove the Nickname property from its XMP metadata using the PdfXmpMetadata facade, and save the updated file.

extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Extract XMP Metadata from PDF
extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF with the PdfXmpMetadata facade, retrieve the raw XMP XML bytes, convert them to a UTF‑8 string, and optionally save the metadata to a file.

read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf__v2.title: Read and Parse XMP Metadata from a PDF
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, extract its XMP metadata as XML, and read specific schema properties such as creator and creation date using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

modify-xmp-creator-property.title: Modify XMP Creator Property in PDF
modify-xmp-creator-property.description: Demonstrates reading XMP metadata from a PDF, updating the dc:creator element, and writing the modified metadata back using Aspose.Pdf.

update-multiple-xmp-properties.title: Update Multiple XMP Properties in a Single Transaction
update-multiple-xmp-properties.description: Shows how to bind a PDF's XMP metadata, modify several properties atomically, and save the changes using a temporary file to ensure an atomic update.

update-xmp-metadata-and-save-pdf.title: Update XMP Metadata and Save PDF
update-xmp-metadata-and-save-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF to the XMP metadata facade, modify Dublin Core properties, and save the document with the updated XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-pages-update-xmp-metadata.title: Insert Pages and Update XMP Metadata in PDF
insert-pages-update-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to insert selected pages from one PDF into another and then add or overwrite XMP metadata before saving the final document.

split-pdf-preserve-xmp-metadata.title: Split PDF into Single Pages While Preserving XMP Metadata
split-pdf-preserve-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to split a multi‑page PDF into individual page files and retain the original XMP metadata on each resulting document using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-xmp-metadata-and-merge-pdfs.title: Copy XMP Metadata and Merge PDFs
copy-xmp-metadata-and-merge-pdfs.description: Shows how to extract XMP metadata from a source PDF with the PdfXmpMetadata facade, apply it to another PDF, and then merge the pages into a new document.

export-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Export XMP Metadata from PDF to a Side‑car File
export-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF document, retrieve its XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and save the metadata to a separate .xmp side‑car file.

replace-pdf-xmp-metadata.title: Replace PDF XMP Metadata from External File
replace-pdf-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, reading an external XMP file and replacing the document's XMP metadata block, then saving the updated PDF.

validate-xmp-metadata-against-the-offici.title: Validate Xmp Metadata Against The Official Xmp Schema Using An Xml Schema Validator

set-xmp-metadata-conditionally-with-warn.title: Set XMP Metadata Conditionally with Warning Logging
set-xmp-metadata-conditionally-with-warn.description: Demonstrates how to add XMP metadata to a PDF only when the target property is empty, logging a warning if the property already contains a non‑empty value.

log-xmp-metadata-size-before-after-modif.title: Log XMP Metadata Size Before and After Modification
log-xmp-metadata-size-before-after-modif.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve, log, and modify the XMP metadata block of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, showing the size before and after the change.

log-original-xmp-metadata.title: Log Original XMP Metadata from PDF
log-original-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to bind a PDF using the PdfXmpMetadata facade, extract the XMP metadata as XML, and save it to a file for audit tracking.

set-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Set PDF Creator Metadata via Extension Method
set-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to create a reusable extension method that assigns the Creator XMP metadata to an Aspose.Pdf Document using the PdfFileInfo facade.

clear-xmp-metadata-pdf.title: Clear All XMP Metadata from PDF while Preserving Header
clear-xmp-metadata-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove all XMP metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, keeping only the mandatory PDF schema header.

remove-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Remove XMP Metadata from PDF
remove-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete the entire XMP metadata block from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save a metadata‑free document.

load-encrypted-pdf-decrypt-save.title: Load Encrypted PDF, Decrypt with Password, and Save Unprotected Copy
load-encrypted-pdf-decrypt-save.description: Demonstrates how to detect an encrypted PDF, handle the InvalidPasswordException, load the document using a password, and save a decrypted version while ensuring proper disposal.

decrypt-update-creatortool-reencrypt-pdf.title: Decrypt PDF, Update CreatorTool, and Re‑encrypt
decrypt-update-creatortool-reencrypt-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open a password‑protected PDF, decrypt it, modify the Creator metadata (CreatorTool), and then re‑apply encryption with new passwords and privileges using Aspose.Pdf.

persist-custom-xmp-metadata-pdf.title: Persist Custom XMP Metadata in PDF
persist-custom-xmp-metadata-pdf.description: The example creates a PDF, sets the Creator property and custom XMP metadata entries (BaseUrl and Nickname) using PdfFileInfo, saves the changes to a new file, and verifies the values with unit tests.

store-extract-unicode-nickname.title: Store and Extract Unicode Nickname in PDF
store-extract-unicode-nickname.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with Unicode characters (Chinese text and emoji) using Aspose.Pdf and verifying the stored value by extracting the text with the PdfExtractor facade.

verify-baseurl-escaping.title: Verify BaseUrl Escaping with Special Characters
verify-baseurl-escaping.description: Shows a unit test that checks the BasePath URI in XfaParserOptions is correctly percent‑escaped for spaces and Unicode characters.

read-xmp-metadata-from-large-pdf.title: Read XMP Metadata from Large PDF and Measure Performance
read-xmp-metadata-from-large-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a large PDF file, extract its XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and benchmark the operation time.

update-pdf-creator-tool-metadata.title: Update PDF CreatorTool Metadata in a Folder
update-pdf-creator-tool-metadata.description: Shows how to scan a directory for PDF files and modify the Creator (CreatorTool) XMP metadata of each file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

update-xmp-property-in-pdf.title: Update XMP Metadata Property in PDF
update-xmp-property-in-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, modify or add an XMP metadata property, and save the updated document.

bind-pdf-byte-array-to-pdfxmpmetadata.title: Bind PDF Byte Array to PdfXmpMetadata and Extract XMP
bind-pdf-byte-array-to-pdfxmpmetadata.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF in memory, bind it from a byte array to the PdfXmpMetadata facade, and retrieve the XMP metadata as a byte array.

read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf-unc.title: Read XMP Metadata from PDF via UNC Path
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf-unc.description: Shows how to bind a PDF located on a network share using a UNC path and extract its XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

list-xmp-namespaces-in-pdf.title: List XMP Namespaces in a PDF
list-xmp-namespaces-in-pdf.description: Shows how to extract the XMP metadata packet from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and enumerate the namespace declarations defined in the XMP XML.

add-minimal-xmp-metadata-fallback.title: Add Minimal XMP Metadata Fallback to PDF
add-minimal-xmp-metadata-fallback.description: Shows how to detect missing XMP metadata in a PDF and inject a minimal set of metadata entries using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-xmp-metadata-to-json.title: Export PDF XMP Metadata to JSON
export-pdf-xmp-metadata-to-json.description: Shows how to extract XMP metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and convert it into JSON format for integration with non‑XML systems.

compress-pdf-read-xmp-metadata.title: Compress PDF with High Settings and Read XMP Metadata
compress-pdf-read-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates compressing a PDF using high‑compression optimization options and then extracting its XMP metadata as an XML string.

validate-mandatory-xmp-metadata.title: Validate Mandatory XMP Metadata Before Publishing PDF
validate-mandatory-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, extract its XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf, verify that required XMP fields are present and non‑empty, and then save the PDF if validation succeeds.

add-xmp-timestamp-to-pdf.title: Add XMP Timestamp to PDF during Generation
add-xmp-timestamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, add a page with sample text, and automatically embed an XMP ModifyDate timestamp into the document metadata.

extract-xmp-metadata-to-dictionary.title: Extract XMP Metadata from PDF to Dictionary
extract-xmp-metadata-to-dictionary.description: Shows how to read the XMP packet from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and convert the XML into a case‑insensitive dictionary of key/value pairs.

set-default-creator-metadata.title: Set Default Creator Metadata for PDF
set-default-creator-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to copy a PDF and ensure the Creator XMP metadata field is populated, using a supplied value or a configurable default when the source PDF lacks it.

disable-baseurl-injection-html-to-pdf.title: Disable BaseUrl Injection When Converting HTML to PDF
disable-baseurl-injection-html-to-pdf.description: Shows how to use a configuration switch to optionally omit the BaseUrl in HtmlLoadOptions while converting HTML to PDF and uses the PdfViewer facade to bind and save the document.

refresh-creatortool-metadata-for-pdfs.title: Refresh CreatorTool Metadata for PDFs
refresh-creatortool-metadata-for-pdfs.description: Shows how to scan a repository of PDF files and update the CreatorTool‑related XMP metadata (Creator, Author, Title) using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.
